table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AccountName=A2.Name,
	TransferAccount=Accounts.Name, 
	Notes.IssueDate,   
	Notes.DueDate,   
	Notes.PostDate,
	Notes.DocumentNumber,   
	Notes.BankName,   
	Notes.Amount,   
	Notes.Remarks,   
	Notes.NoteCode,
	Notes.Posted
FROM Notes,   
	Accounts, Accounts A2
WHERE 
	Notes.BankAccCode = Accounts.AccCode and  
	Notes.AccCode = A2.AccCode and  
	Notes.NoteCatCode = 1 AND  
	CASE UPPER(:as_datetype) 
			When 'DUEDATE' Then Notes.DueDate 
			When 'POSTDATE' Then Notes.PostDate 
			When 'ISSUEDATE' Then Notes.IssueDate End 
				Between :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	(Notes.Posted = Case :as_status 
		WHEN 'B' THEN 'Y' 
		WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y' 
		WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
		ELSE 'Z' END OR
	Notes.Posted = Case :as_status
		WHEN 'B' THEN 'N'
		WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y'
		WHEN 'N' THEN 'N'
		ELSE 'Z'
		END)
